steps.note: R.2.1 and R.2.1.1 assert the lemma's conclusion (arbitrary initial auxiliary values; each auxiliary value 'cancelled and then restored', quote at line 730), but the plan never gives the row-by-row derivation that the first rows subtract Ja+Rc, the middle rows add R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx), and the last rows restore, leaving net (JV+RG)x independent of a,c; it names the idea without the content.

No step gives the bit-case central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, the side-wire cancellation of intersection-one cases, or the self coefficient one; R.2.3 only says coefficients 'depend on intersection sizes'.
The complex-case central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 and the cancellation of intersections zero and two do not appear anywhere in the plan.

R.2.1.2 states that the three stages send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and, quoting line 764, that each invocation restores its own auxiliary wires; the intermediate pairs (x,y+x) and (-y,y+x) and the forward/inverse/forward roles are not spelled out, so this is a borderline credit.

The plan says labels are nested, but gives no per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions (no residual table, no tensor splits by B, P, F, Q); R.2.4 only says 'bound the loss of the decreasing edges'.
No step mentions the side edge 2->5, t_X ⊥ t_Y, the inclusion <t_X> ⊂ t_Y^⊥, or the complement <t_X,t_Y>^⊥ of dimension h-2.

R.2.3.3 (quote at line 1061) says only the central return 3->4 decreases a label, and that absolute changes total Wm-2N+2L; R.2.3.2 gives signed sum Wm-2N via gate cancellation; the explicit source total N, sink total Wm-N and per-edge loss h are not stated, so this is a condensed but faithful version.

The plan never states that each nonzero residual over F_2 is nondegenerate and nonalternating, nor that it has an orthonormal basis or how alternating planes are absorbed; R.2.7 only speaks of 'residual directions' and a 'residual basis'.
R.2.4.1 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2.

R.2.7 says only 'write each residual direction as a Hamming-weight phase'; the additivity of weight mod 4 for orthogonal vectors and the formula q_V-q_U = sum of wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal basis are not given.
The plan never states that wt(v) is odd, the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, or that H diag(1,-1) H = X turns it into a translation kernel aI+bX_v; 'two-point kernel' is named without derivation.
R.2.7.1 gives a product of kernels C, one per residual direction (single column), but nothing about k columns with a tensor power per residual vector or the total of s_c factors.

R.2.7.2 states only C^{-1}=-iZCZ as the cost of an inverse child (quote from line 1883); the endpoint analysis is missing: zero label frame I, full label C^{⊗m}, C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), repair by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k}, negating the X outputs.
R.2.4.1 gives L/N<1/2, R.2.4.3 states the deficit Wm-s equals N-2L and is positive because L<N/2, and R.2.4.2 gives s=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, matching the paper's bit-network proposition.
The value eta_b=339/22587335000000 (relative deficit) is not stated anywhere in the plan.
The value eta_c=73/19906842167500 is not stated anywhere in the plan.

R.2.4.4 and R.2.4.5 assert the conclusion s/W<m^tau and m^sigma with tau=sigma=1-2^-50 (quoting lines 1341-1342) but give none of the derivation: deficits exceeding 20*2^-50, log m<20, and m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-eta).

R.2.5.1 states the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 (quote from the lemma statement, line 1366) but the plan gives no elimination proof: no pivot at the rightmost entry of the topmost nonzero row, clearing by lower-triangular operations, or repetition on active indices.
The plan never mentions the fixed odd prime avoiding denominators in a finite table, or the specialization of the identities to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.

R.2.5's motivation only asserts that lower-triangular updates are linear-time; the mechanism (update coordinates in descending physical order so earlier coordinates keep their original values) is not given.
R.2.5.2 and R.2.5.3 give, for each one at (i,j) of Pi, the sequence D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j with one interchange, and R.2.5 states exactly a interchanges in all.
R.2.9.4 quotes only E=64(W+m+1)^3 and B=s+E; nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3}, C_0=128mB^2 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) (with nu=11, C_1=20) are not stated, so the guard width is never defined.
No arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with leaf A(e)<=8e or the per-invocation count below E; R.2.9.1 gives only the time recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O(...), a different quantity.
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} and the total below C_0 d^{C_1} do not appear in the plan.

R.2.9.4 says only that coefficients are exact in O(p) bits; the depth-l bound (values in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^l), the p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits, and epsilon*C_1<1 giving Delta=o(p) are not stated.

R.2.9.5 states only that the layer returns Q_p(Hz) in O(V d^{lambda'}) time; nothing says every row of H has absolute row sum one, that disks are preserved, or that the final truncation errs by less than sqrt2*2^-p.

summary: P01 carries 5 of 26 sub-steps present: B4 (borderline, three-stage exchange with per-invocation restoration), L3 (decreasing edge 3->4, signed Wm-2N, absolute +2L), L5 (100/539 and 101/539), R1 (L/N<1/2 giving deficit N-2L>0 and s<Wm), M4 (one interchange per one of Pi). The plan mostly cites the paper's lemma statements and conclusions (e.g. lines 730, 1366, 1341-1342, 2459, 2663) without the proofs: it has none of the bit/complex coefficient checks (B2, B3), the residual table and side-edge argument (L1, L2), the orthonormal-basis argument (L4), any of the phase-interface derivation (P1-P4), the explicit eta values and exponent derivation (R2-R4), the elimination proof, prime choice and descending-order cost (M1-M3), or the guard-width recurrence and its consequences (S1-S5).
